detail.title: Analysis of Interaction Coupling and Value Canalization
detail.summary: Reviewed experiment exp-divergent-values-test-78, which showed that interaction-coupling constrains variance (divergence ratio 1.028, within tolerance 1.1). Interpretation suggests that canalization effectively limits value divergence in the tested system. Proceeding with refinement of the hypothesis to explore the limits of this stabilization under higher coupling variance.
